title: Breakaway civilization behind the men at the door

tellings.quote: I think there is a breakaway civilization and we're talking about it right now.

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber, who says he has met non-human beings, tells a podcast host that he thinks there is a breakaway civilization: a hidden group of people who have split off from the rest of society with secret knowledge and technology. The story's title ties this idea to men who came to his door. If true, it would mean someone other than ordinary government is behind some of what people experience.
